annotation.bound_parties_text: The practice states that the A-UGV test configuration information shall be recorded, directed at those conducting A-UGV tests and reporting results (the user of the standard).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to establish appropriate safety, health, and environmental practices
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This international standard was developed in accordance with internationally recognized principles on standardization established in the Decision on Principles for the Development of International Standards
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ASTM F3327-18 Standard Practice for Recording the A-UGV Test Configuration
